note: An example project config for the shared engine. Orchestra's setup screen writes this file for new projects (plan 0012); copy this one by hand only to see what it holds. It lives at <project>/.orchestra/orchestrator.json (a workspace that has not run plan 0007's move yet: <project>/orchestrator/orchestrator.json) and replace the placeholders: repos (folder names under root), verifyCommands (that project's gate commands), description (the two lines `run.ps1 help` prints), planFiling (number or slug), contractDoc (optional: the frontend contract doc relative to root; default Web/.ai/architecture/api-surface-v3.md). Everything else is the engine's behaviour and is the same in every project.

description.title: orchestrator / run.ps1 - multi-agent, four-gate driver for <Project>
description.repos: - Repos: <RepoA>, <RepoB> - separate git repos under one workspace root. The root is not a git repo.

plan-reviewer.note: Gate 2 skips any hop of the plan author's family.

readback.note: Gate 2.5, run by another family than the implementer. Remove this role to fall back to the implementer chain.

adapterTransport: How the orchestrator talks to each agent. "cli": it runs `command` itself and reads the answer from stdout. "inbox": it writes the prompt to runs/<id>/inbox/<key>.md, stops with exit 3, and a human pastes one line into the agent; the agent writes runs/<id>/answers/<key>.md and the same run.ps1 command picks it up. An inbox hop is only allowed in plan-reviewer, readback and verifier. Missing transport: manual = inbox, every other adapter = cli.

tiers.note: What `free` and `paid` mean. maxConcurrent - how many hops of this pool may run at once, 0 = unlimited. minGapSec - the least time between the starts of two hops. rateLimitRetries / rateLimitBackoffSec - attempts and wait after a 429. whenBusy - wait for a free slot or take the next hop. queueWaitSec - how long `wait` waits before queue-timeout.

claude.note: OAuth pro; the orchestrator strips ANTHROPIC_* before the call. -p --output-format text prints nothing until it ends, so the idle timeout is off.

modelRatesSource.note: Live prices, fetched at most once per maxAgeHours and cached in runs/_model-rates.json. No network: the cached copy; no cache: modelRates below.

modelRates.note: Fallback prices, USD per 1,000,000 tokens, keyed by the exact model string the ledger writes.

preflight.pingPrompt: Reply with exactly one word: PONG

revise.note: auto plan->review rounds after the first review while the verdict is FINDINGS

readback.note: gate 2.5: the readback role's chain (else the implementer chain), read-only, reports where it would have to guess

quota.note: A hop whose output matches one of these is out of quota for its whole pool: no retry, the pool is marked exhausted for exhaustedSec.

sessions.note: A role's later rounds continue the same agent session with a short follow-up prompt instead of re-sending the whole plan.

archive.note: close writes runs/_archive/<id>.<yyyyMMddHHmm>.json (task.json, review / read-back / verify texts, session usage) before deleting the run.

cleanTree.note: Uncommitted paths under these prefixes never block gate 3: they are records (plans, session logs), not code.

report.note: Fire-and-forget events to the dashboard (plan 0004). off by default: with enabled false or no block nothing is sent. The token is read from the named environment variable, never from this file. A run behaves the same with the dashboard down.
